title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Liguria and Lombardy. We keep them in our thoughts with gratitude and respect.

women.name: Eva del Transito Azocar Chavez
tribute: Eva del Transito Azocar Chavez was 63 years old and lived in the Marassi district of Genoa, in Liguria. She was born in Chile. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Gallarate
tribute: She was 55 years old and is in our thoughts.
